scenes.title: The Broken Caravan
scenes.readAloud: The wind off the salt flats carries a smell that shouldn't be there — burnt leather, and something sweeter underneath. Ahead, a merchant caravan lies scattered across the road, one wagon on its side, wheels still slowly turning.
scenes.gmNotes: The caravan was hit twenty minutes ago. Survivors are hiding in the rocks fifty yards off the road (Perception DV 3 to spot them). If the party investigates quietly, they can question a survivor before the bandits (still nearby, looting) notice them.

combatants.name: Bandit Leader
combatants.notes: Wields a curved blade, will flee at half HP

scenes.title: The Survivor's Account
scenes.readAloud: The caravan master, bloodied but alive, grips your arm. 'They knew our route. Someone sold us out. Please — my daughter was taken toward the Hollow Cisterns.'
scenes.gmNotes: This is the pivot scene. The party can pursue immediately (-> scene-2-1) or investigate who leaked the route first (a Lore/Subterfuge scene left to the GM/AI to run ad-hoc — log it as a beat rather than a scripted scene).

scenes.title: Descent Into the Cisterns
scenes.readAloud: The old cisterns were sealed a generation ago. Now the seal is broken, and lantern-light flickers somewhere far below.
scenes.gmNotes: This is the adventure's climax. Whoever is holding the caravan master's daughter is a matter for the GM/AI to decide based on earlier play (the leaked-route thread from scene-1-2, if pursued). Start an ad-hoc encounter here with a synthetic encounterId and an explicit combatants list rather than a pre-scripted one, since the final fight should reflect what actually happened earlier at the table.
